action: Execute the 30-day workforce vulnerability map for all four Regional Auto Group locations. Systematically audit every role — service technicians, sales staff, finance and insurance officers, lot attendants, administrative staff, parts department, management — and classify each as: (1) EV/AV-exposed: tasks that autonomous vehicle technology or EV service shift directly displaces or degrades; (2) transition-ready: roles with transferable skills that could move into adjacent functions with training investment; (3) anchored: roles with durable demand regardless of EV/AV adoption curve. Deliverable format: structured role-by-role matrix per location, with exposure scores, estimated displacement timelines, transition pathway recommendations, and retraining cost-benefit analysis. Frame the document to serve Patricia's operational needs while also serving as a template methodology she will eventually need external consulting support to replicate — which is exactly what Angela's consulting entity will offer.
